Anyways, here are the assignments for each thing on the MIDI Keyboard:

7 touch keys - CDEFGAB
3 drum pads - Kick, snare, closed hi-hat
Switch 1 - 1 octave down
Switch 2 - 1 octave up
Switch 3 - sustain till held
Slider 1 - Volume
Slider 2  - Modulation
